identity.scope: Technical component ownership and internal system-service contracts for the Ivan-VHS repository federation.

components.name: KernelCore
current_scope: Experimental x86_64 Stage 1 firmware handoff and Boot Info v1 validation.
Early 4 KiB physical-frame allocation and QEMU BIOS/UEFI boot checks.
missing_capabilities: Reusable physical-memory manager, page tables and address-space management.
Interrupts, timers, preemptive scheduling, process model and syscall ABI.
Kernel-enforced capabilities, native IPC, device enumeration and driver runtime.
interfaces: Reaper reference policy contracts; native enforcement remains pending.

components.name: NexusShell
current_scope: Mora local browser-host desktop, launcher, windows, preferences and application panels.
missing_capabilities: Native shell session launched by the DuckOS kernel.
Native window server, input routing, compositor and kernel-backed application lifecycle.
interfaces: Mora local application registry and host-side integration contracts.

components.name: AudioSubsys
current_scope: VentuSample provides independent C++20 offline rendering, DSP, asset I/O and versioned pack/preset metadata.
missing_capabilities: DuckOS audio-device discovery, native driver interface and session ownership.
Real-time callback scheduling, bounded device buffers and hardware-backed latency qualification.
interfaces: Offline render metadata; no real-time device ABI is published.

components.name: SecurityModule
current_scope: Reaper reference capability and trust-state policies.
DuckOS BAV declarative bundle v1 format and schema.
OPlague read-only device, package, Authenticode, hash and telemetry evidence.
missing_capabilities: Kernel-enforced access control and protected event delivery.
Native bundle signature verification, endpoint scanner, quarantine store and enforcement broker.
Verified boot trust chain and key lifecycle.

components.name: NetworkStack
current_scope: Reaper reference contracts validate selected network policy inputs; they do not transmit packets.
missing_capabilities: NIC drivers, packet buffers, IP/TCP/UDP, routes and socket API.
Firewall hooks, resolver, VPN transport and hardware-backed network telemetry.
interfaces: No native DuckOS network-service ABI is published.

components.name: GraphicsEngine
current_scope: Mora host-browser rendering and documented desktop interaction/design policies.
missing_capabilities: Native GPU driver, resource handles, window server and compositor.
Display discovery, presentation scheduling and device-loss recovery.
interfaces: Mora design tokens and host-browser application surfaces; no native compositor ABI.

components.name: BuildToolchain
current_scope: Reaper language frontend, diagnostics, CLI/REPL, reference runtime and developer tools.
Experimental native C17 implementation with separate conformance maturity.
missing_capabilities: Feature-equivalent native compiler and complete freestanding DuckOS backend.
Self-hosting bootstrap and reproducible native link/load pipeline.
interfaces: Versioned C ABI v1 through an explicit trusted library path.

components.name: AILayer
missing_capabilities: No model runtime, inference contract, model provenance, data policy or resource governor is assigned.

services.name: KERNEL_SENTINEL
services.purpose: Read-only integrity measurement and policy reporting for trusted system artifacts.
prerequisites: Kernel-backed immutable measurement source and authenticated event stream.
Local trust store with key rotation, revocation and signature verification.
Bounded isolated scanner worker and audit-ready evidence reports.
outputs: Versioned integrity report with object identity, digest, measurement source and verification state.
Explicit unknown, unsupported, stale and failed-verification states.
host_technology_options: TPM 2.0 may be an optional provider after a DuckOS driver and trust chain exist.
Linux IMA and eBPF are host-adapter options, not native DuckOS APIs.
services.safety_boundary: Read-only initially; process-memory scanning, injection prevention, quarantine, execution blocking and kernel enforcement are not implemented.

services.name: MEMORY_FORGE
services.purpose: Read-only memory-resource inventory and bounded diagnostics, with future advisory policies for memory pressure.
prerequisites: Reusable frame allocator and page-table/address-space accounting.
Per-process memory ownership and page-state reporting.
Explicit RAM, swap and accelerator-memory provider contracts.
outputs: Memory snapshots with provider, timestamp, units and validity.
Advisory resource reports and bounded compression/reclamation proposals.
host_technology_options: malloc and mmap hooks do not replace kernel memory accounting.
Zstd/LZ4 page compression requires page ownership, backing storage, recovery and CPU/memory budgets.
VRAM data must come from a supported GPU provider; arbitrary device-memory mapping is prohibited.
services.safety_boundary: Observational first; allocator replacement, page migration, swap mutation, memory reclamation and VRAM mapping remain disabled until native authorization and rollback tests exist.

services.name: VECTOR_GATEWAY
services.purpose: Local network-policy service for traffic visibility, explicit filtering rules and future encrypted transport integration.
prerequisites: Real NIC driver, packet buffers and a network data path.
Versioned socket, route and packet-filter contracts.
Bounded parsing, queue/rate limits, audit and packet-path tests.
outputs: Versioned network status and policy reports.
Dry-run rule plans until the native packet path exists.
host_technology_options: nftables and XDP are Linux-host adapter options, not DuckOS kernel APIs.
WireGuard requires a separately reviewed protocol and cryptographic implementation.
DoH/DoT require a supported resolver and explicit trust policy.
services.safety_boundary: No DDoS mitigation, firewall enforcement, VPN protection or packet prioritization is claimed before a real, tested network service exists.

services.name: PIXEL_PIPELINE
services.purpose: Native window composition, display presentation, input-to-frame coordination and frame diagnostics.
prerequisites: Native window/session manager and input routing.
GPU discovery, driver ABI and validated resource handles.
Compositor API, display discovery and presentation/recovery tests.
outputs: Composited frames through the native display interface.
Frame timing and presentation diagnostics with provider provenance.
host_technology_options: Vulkan is optional after a supported DuckOS backend and driver exist.
Wayland is a protocol compatibility option, not an assumed DuckOS compositor.
DRM/KMS is a Linux host boundary, not a native DuckOS subsystem.
services.safety_boundary: Applications receive validated graphics resources, not arbitrary VRAM mappings; Mora browser rendering is not native composition.

services.name: DATA_ORCHESTRATOR
services.purpose: Process and task lifecycle coordinator with bounded scheduling requests and observable service state.
prerequisites: Process/thread model, address-space isolation and syscall ABI.
Preemptive scheduler, cancellation semantics and authenticated IPC.
Kernel-enforced capabilities, resource accounting and service lifecycle tests.
host_technology_options: cgroups v2, Linux namespaces and systemd are not native DuckOS dependencies.
A Linux compatibility adapter may be developed independently.
services.safety_boundary: No process creation, priority mutation, container isolation or service supervision is exposed until the corresponding OS primitives are implemented and verified.

services.name: BUILD_VANGUARD
services.purpose: Explicitly configured build and validation coordinator for local projects and CI jobs.
prerequisites: Versioned build-job manifest with allowlisted targets and resource limits.
Pinned toolchain identity, reproducible environment and artifact metadata.
Isolated execution backend for untrusted inputs, test and provenance collection.
outputs: Reproducible build plans and per-target test reports.
Artifact inventory, digests and provenance records.
host_technology_options: Existing GitHub Actions workflows remain the actual CI execution mechanism until a local service exists.
Reaper native compiler maturity is partial; external compilers require explicit project build contracts.
services.safety_boundary: User-space only; no implicit shell execution, dependency download, signing-key access, untrusted builds or release publication.

integration_invariants: DuckOS and Reaper remain canonical OS and language names; component labels never rename repositories or public products.
Reaper owns language and policy semantics; DuckOS owns privileged kernel operations, service lifecycle and native enforcement.
No service is a runnable microservice until process isolation, service lifecycle, authenticated IPC and kernel-enforced capabilities exist.
Cross-repository exchanges use existing versioned contracts or reviewed schemas with bounded payloads, provenance and typed failure states.
Missing, stale, unsupported or invalid providers remain explicit; measurements and execution results are never invented.
Default behavior is local-first and read-only; network access, process execution and privileged hardware actions require scoped authorization.
Linux-specific facilities are optional host adapters and do not silently become DuckOS kernel dependencies.
Source, tests, CI output and target verification determine maturity; catalogs and architecture documents do not prove runtime behavior.
